## Pull Request

**Description**
A clear and concise description of what this pull request does.

**Related Issue**
Link to the issue that this pull request addresses (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

**Type of Change**
- Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- Documentation update

**Testing**
- Unity Editor version(s) tested: [e.g. 6000.3.5f1]
- URP version(s) tested: [e.g. 17.3.0]
- Platform(s) tested: [e.g. Editor, Android device/chipset, Windows Standalone]

**Checklist**
- [ ] My code follows the coding standard of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (README, Options Reference, etc.)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors in the Unity Console
- [ ] I have added or updated `.meta` files for any new/moved/renamed assets
- [ ] I have tested in both the Editor and on at least one target device/platform
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules

**Additional Context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the pull request here.
